title: Effect of Abstractions and Prompting Strategies on LLM-Guided High-Performance Optimizations
abstract: arXiv:2608.08085v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Code performance optimization is a vital aspect of modern software development, as it enables faster response times and reduced resource usage. These optimizations require a deep understanding of low-level hardware details and the intricacies of parallel processing, making them challenging even for experienced developers. With the advent of Large Language Models (LLMs), which are increasingly capable of generating and understanding code, there is growing interest in incorporating these models into automated code optimization processes. Traditionally, this automation involves transcribing the source code into a domain-specific representation that can be auto-tuned using grid search or machine learning algorithms, while adhering to strict rules and a limited set of feasible transformations to ensure verifiability. translated_title: 抽象与提示策略对LLM引导高性能优化的影响
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08085v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：代码性能优化是现代软件开发的一个重要方面，因为它能实现更快的响应时间和更低的资源使用率。这些优化需要对底层硬件细节和并行处理的复杂性有深入理解，即使对经验丰富的开发者也具有挑战性。随着大型语言模型（LLM）的出现，它们越来越擅长生成和理解代码，人们越来越有兴趣将这些模型纳入自动化代码优化流程中。传统上，这种自动化涉及将源代码转录为特定领域表示，可通过网格搜索或机器学习算法进行自动调优，同时遵循严格规则和有限的可验证变换集以确保可验证性。LLM融入了高级代码语义，因此能够执行超越可验证自动化优化范围的变换。
tldr: 本文探讨了抽象层级和提示策略如何影响LLM在高性能代码优化中的效果，发现LLM能利用高级语义实现传统自动化方法无法覆盖的变换，但需权衡可验证性。
en_tdlr: This paper investigates how abstraction levels and prompting strategies affect LLM-guided high-performance optimizations, showing that LLMs leverage high-level semantics to perform transformations beyond verifiable automated methods, though with trade-offs in verifiability.
